bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_HOST_DIAG_BEGIN\n'
printf 'TARGET_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TARGET_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_ACCOUNT_SECRET_PRESENT='; test -f deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'USERBOT_IPC_PRESENT='; test -S deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'GAYBBS_HOST_DIAG_END\n'
